text: **Use parameterized queries always** — `$db->prepare()` + `$stmt->execute([...])` — never string interpolation - **Add LIMIT to `fetchAll()`** — unbounded queries on large tables (orders, content, logs) will exhaust memory - **Use per-request static caches** for settings/config/form-field reads (see standard below) - **Batch queries** — one query that returns 100 rows is faster than 100 queries returning 1 row each
